notes.title: Difficulty Increase Notice
notes.content:
Difficulty Increase Notice

Due to a previous patch that lowered the difficulty, some segments became too easy. Instead of altering the core mechanics, we've decided to raise the obstacle difficulty. While there haven't been significant changes, the overall difficulty remains easier compared to before April 12th.

[list]
[*] Increased difficulty in intermittent cliff segments
[*] Raised difficulty in reconfigured segments
[*] Removal of some obstacles in ice segments
[*] Fix for sliding bug on ice bridges
[*] Fine-tuning of Oak Tree segment
[*] Introduction of new obstacles in bamboo segments
[*] Minor adjustments in other segments
[/list]

Difficulty increase in the mid-to-late game
Although we've increased the difficulty in some segments, it's not our intention to make every segment challenging. Our goal is to create a game that most people can clear with time investment. Some segments are designed to be easy when rolling down or ascending quickly.

The game is not challenging yet. We need your opinion on this.

However, there are concerns about the mid-game difficulty being too easy. We will actively consider and incorporate user feedback. Please leave your comments below. Thank you.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Update details
[list]
[*] Camera FOV effect has been added, activated while running.
[*] Some maps have been modified. (No major changes.)
[*] Slight increase in ball wobbling in water sections.
[*] Difficulty of bronze, silver, and gold balls has been adjusted upwards.
[*] Bug fix: Ending credits not displaying correctly when reached with the beach ball.
[*] When the ball is far away, the camera now appears closer.
[*] Respawn distance for the ball has been slightly increased.
[*] Difficulty has been raised in the mid to late game.
[*] Duck ball has been added. (Quack quack)
[/list]
[list]
[*] A ball for speedrunning, Sapphire, has been added (beta version).
[*] Sapphire Ball:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948270/edb6e55027bd4cd2dbb5fae61620800dda70691d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Moves at twice the speed of regular balls.
[*] Controls are a bit more challenging but balanced compared to regular balls.
[/list]
[*] Developer's comment:
[*] Sapphire Ball has been added for users seeking faster gameplay. It is currently in beta testing and has a lower difficulty level than anticipated. Moving the ball faster than Sisyphus caused several issues. If the ball moves too fast, it becomes challenging to control, leading to difficulties in character interaction. We believe this game is not like "Getting over it" or "A difficult game about Climbing," where an experienced player can clear the game in a short time. Gameplay time doesn't significantly differ between beginners and experts. We apologize to players who were not satisfied with the game. We'll strive to solve as many issues as possible and improve both the Sapphire Ball and the game in the future. Currently, it's not recommended for speedrunning. Please leave your comments below the post. We'll try new ideas and respond to them. Thank you.
[/list]


https://x.com/GameofSisyphus/status/1780618324424233378

notes.title: Balance Update
notes.content:
Hello, we are the development team behind "The Game of Sisyphus."

With this update, the difficulty has slightly increased. 
The balance update includes the following changes:

[list]
[*] Some overly challenging sections have been slightly adjusted.
[*] The force of boulders falling downward has slightly increased.
[*] The strength to hold boulders manually has slightly decreased.
[/list]

Since the release, some players found the default gameplay too difficult to progress. 
Therefore, we significantly lowered the difficulty level (Update 4/12). 
However, this update inadvertently made sections with uneven floors too easy and almost non-functional as intended. 
Additionally, the slowed speed of falling boulders led to too many instances where boulders were stopped safely. 
To address these issues, we conducted this update.
With this update, the difficulty has increased by approximately 20% from the previous downward adjustment level.
However, please do not worry as the increase in difficulty is not significant.

Our goal is to make our game accessible to most players.
While Rage Games that require over 20 hours of play might be entertaining for streaming, we aim to create a game where anyone can feel a sense of accomplishment with just time and patience. 
For skilled players, challenging yourself with heavier and harder-to-control balls like Iron ball, Bronze ball, etc., can be rewarding.

Thank you, and we will support you in your journey.

tags.balance_change: [*] Some overly challenging sections have been slightly adjusted.

[*] The strength to hold boulders manually has slightly decreased.

notes.title: Balance Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] We have adjusted the difficulty of the game.
[*] We made it easier to grab rocks with stronger hand strength. It's now easier to roll rocks even on more curved surfaces.
[*] We reduced the force at which rocks roll downward.
[*] We have added more objects for rocks to catch onto in the middle.
[/list]
